concepts.label: Sub-Document LOOKUPIN operation (advancedLookupInField)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - genuinely new mechanism: a CAS-free sub-document read (`couchbase.lookupIn` + `couchbase.LookupInSpec.get(path, {xattrs})`) that fetches specific fields/paths within a document rather than the whole document, distinct from the whole-document GET/INSERT/DELETE/INCREMENT/DECREMENT operations covered elsewhere in this batch

relations.evidence: For more information about the Advanced Sub-Document LOOKUPIN operation, see [Sub-Document LOOKUPIN Operation](eventing-advanced-keyspace-accessors.md#advanced-subdoc-array-op-lookupin).

notable_absence.finding: The page references an `{"xattrs": false}` option on `LookupInSpec.get(...)` but never defines what an xattr (extended attribute) is or why a caller would set it true/false - readers must consult eventing-advanced-keyspace-accessors.md for that context, which this page links to but does not summarize. This page is also the only one in the batch citing a single 'Version 7.6+' tier rather than the usual 3-tier 7.1+/7.0+/6.6.x ladder - a variation on the recurring server-version-string-citation pattern, not an exact repeat.
